text:
nina: quick QA/design pair on the p95 brush persistence + sampling interactions. During a demo a PM clicked the sampling dropdown while the p95 brush was active and the brush reset to default range. can we ensure brush state survives and sampling changes only update rendering, not selection?
jon: yeah that was deliberate earlier when we thought sampling would change bucket boundaries. but we can persist brush in URL state and reapply mapping after sampling change. will need to confirm monotonic mapping for quantiles.
sam: a11y: when brush is active and you toggle sampling, screen readers report focus moved to document body. we need to set focus back to brush handle and announce new sampling rate. add aria-live region with 'Sampling set to 5% — brush preserved'.
olivia: copy tweaks: 'Preserve selection' CTA in the confirmation snackbar is a bit odd. what about 'Keep my selection' and secondary 'Reset to default'? also add short hint: 'Selection is preserved across sampling presets unless bucket boundaries change.'
reza: engineering note: when swapping sampling tables we recompute buckets asynchronously. store prior brush position in normalized coordinates [0..1] and remap to new buckets once computed to avoid magic offsets. also debounce the mapping during rapid preset changes.
nina: mobile UX: when brush handle is focused, we should enlarge hit area to 48px to make dragging easier with thumb. also animate handle scale slightly on touchstart.
jon: adding CSS snippet for enlarged handle hit target:
```css
.brush-handle { position: relative; }
.brush-handle::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -12px; }
```
sam: screen reader strings: 'p95 brush handle, start 12% end 20, drag with arrow keys' and aria-valuetext should format as percent. ensure we do not read thrashing updates while dragging; set aria-live to polite and rate-limit announcements.
olivia: design question: do we show a 'preserve brush' toggle in settings? might be overkill. i prefer ephemeral snackbar with 'Keep my selection' for first toggle and don't surface as persistent toggles.
reza: agree on ephemeral. quick perf caveat: the remap algorithm is CPU bound for very large histograms; we can offload to a worker and show skeleton while computing. keep UI snappy.
a11y-bot: checklist: 'brush focus restored after sampling change', 'aria-live for sampling announcements rate-limited', 'normalized coord remap', 'handle hit area >= 48px', 'snackbar copy updated to Keep my selection'. link: https://staging.redwood.com/a11y/brush-172
nina: owners: jon (persist focus + URL state), reza (normalized remap + worker), sam (VO strings + rate-limit), olivia (snackbar copy + animation). I'll open a ticket and attach mocks. closing thread, thanks! :white_check_mark:
